values.title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Direct Bulk Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Guess some companies see danger when offered a run in Pyro. We see profits. Got one here that starts in the system at [LOCATION] and then goes to [DESTINATION].

The client warned us that outlaws in Pyro regularly target this run, which has scared other hauling concerns. Be sure your ship is all geared up and can hold 24 SCU cargo containers. And don't forget to bring a handheld tractor beam.

values.title: Junior Hauler Needed for Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (4 SCU or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Direct Bulk Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a contract from a major client who needs a skilled pilot to move a large load of luxury items from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].

You'll need room for at least 8 SCU cargo containers in your hold. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded and unloaded.

And as a fair warning, the things you'll be carrying are pricey enough that you might attract some unwanted attention. Be ready to defend yourself if you can't evade.
